fact: 70.3 per cent of the population of Cape Verde used the internet in 2021, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
73.3 per cent of the population of Cape Verde used the internet in 2022, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.

INE's IMC 2025 household survey finds 77.3% of individuals aged 10 and over used the internet in the three months before the survey.

Cabo Verde's national statistics institute INE, from its 2024 continuous multi-purpose household survey, puts internet use at 74% of people aged 10 and over (urban 77%, rural 64%), up from 70% in 2023.
